definitions.explanation: A ceremony marking the start of an activity, such as a project, a new bus or train service, a training course, or a local tournament or event. It is a plain, descriptive word, used where no more specific name for the ceremony is established.

examples.japanese: {開始式|かいししき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{行|おこな}われた→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
⟦プロジェクト→プロジェクト：06764_purojekuto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{開始式|かいししき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{関係者|かんけいしゃ}→関係者：16441_kankeisha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{集|あつ}まった→集まる：01162_atsumaru⟧。
examples.english: Everyone involved gathered for the project's kick-off ceremony.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦バス→バス：00769_basu⟧⟦{路線|ろせん}→路線：11341_rosen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{運行|うんこう}→運行：14375_unkou⟧{開始式|かいししき}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{市長|しちょう}→市長：12472_shichou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦テープ→テープ：01535_teepu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{切|き}った→切る：02693_kiru⟧。
examples.english: At the ceremony marking the start of the new bus service, the mayor cut the ribbon.

examples.japanese: ⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{少年|しょうねん}→少年：03238_shounen⟧⟦サッカー→サッカー：04726_sakkaa⟧⟦{大会|たいかい}→大会：03386_taikai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{開始式|かいししき}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧⟦{代表|だいひょう}→代表：03419_daihyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{宣誓|せんせい}して→宣誓する：22627_senseisuru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{試合|しあい}→試合：01601_shiai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{始|はじ}まる→始まる：00841_hajimaru⟧。
examples.english: The local youth soccer tournament opens with a ceremony at which a representative of the players takes the oath, and then the matches begin.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{開始|かいし}→開始：02537_kaishi⟧ (start) and {式|しき} (ceremony). A plain, descriptive name for a ceremony that starts something: a project kick-off, a new bus or train service (⟦{運行|うんこう}→運行：14375_unkou⟧{開始式|かいししき}), a training course, a small local tournament. Where an occasion has its own established word (below), use that word instead.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {開始式|かいししき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧: to hold an opening ceremony
- {開始式|かいししき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出席|しゅっせき}する→出席する：01830_shussekisuru⟧: to attend one

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{開会式|かいかいしき}→開会式：27306_kaikaishiki⟧: opening of a meeting, convention, or large event such as the Olympics
- {開幕式|かいまくしき}: opening of a sports season or a long-running event
- ⟦{起工式|きこうしき}→起工式：23578_kikoushiki⟧: groundbreaking ceremony, for the start of construction
- ⟦{始業式|しぎょうしき}→始業式：08555_shigyoushiki⟧: ceremony at the start of a school term
- ⟦{閉会式|へいかいしき}→閉会式：26936_heikaishiki⟧: closing ceremony
